name: gitea_repo_ingest
description: Research KB skill: ingest public Git repositories or configured Gitea repositories through OpenClaw code understanding plus deterministic ls-remote, optional shallow clone, bounded large-repository context sampling, source manifest, and catalog writers.
input: Research KB backend task payload JSON from the payload file named in the OpenClaw message.
output: prepare emits analysis context with repo metadata and analysisLimits or writes a skip result with a stable repository-level sourceItems[] record when unchanged; validate-pages checks generated pages JSON before Gitea writes; apply writes a resultFile JSON envelope with success, processedSources, createdPages, updatedPages, archivedFiles, skippedSources, errors, commitId, snapshot, and one repository-level sourceItems[] record for backend persistence.
